Syed Muhammad Ahsan Ghazali
{{small|[[Chief financial officer|CFO]]}}{{cite web|last1=|title=Management |url=https://www.siemens.com/pk/en/company/about/management.html|publisher=Siemens Pakistan |accessdate=10 April 2025}} | products = Industrial and buildings [[automation]], [[Siemens Digital Industries Software|PLM software]] | brands = | production = | services = [[Tertiary sector of the economy|Business services]], [[Project engineering|project]] and [[construction management]] | revenue = {{Increase}} {{PKRConvert|35.166|b}} | revenue_year = 2024 | operating_income = {{decrease}} {{PKRConvert|156.396|m}} | income_year = 2024 | net_income = {{decrease}} {{PKRConvert|−2.048|b}} | net_income_year = 2024 | assets = {{decrease}} {{PKRConvert|31.497|b}} | assets_year = 2024 | equity = {{decrease}} {{PKRConvert|5.396|b}} | equity_year = 2024 | num_employees = 487 | num_employees_year = 2024 | owner = [[Siemens AG]] (92.40%) | parent = [[Siemens]] | subsidiaries = | website = {{URL|siemens.com.pk}} | footnotes = Financials {{as of|2024|9|30|lc=y}} {{cite web|title=Siemens Pakistan Annual Report 2024|url=https://financials.psx.com.pk/lib/DownloadPDF.php?id=244806 |access-date=29 August 2024}} }} '''Siemens (Pakistan) Engineering Company Limited''' is a Pakistani [[engineering in Pakistan|engineering]] services company headquartered in [[Karachi]].{{cite web|title=Siemens Pakistan profile|url=http://www.siemens.com.pk/spak-profile.html|publisher=Siemens Pakistan profile|accessdate=26 August 2014}} It is a subsidiary of [[Siemens AG]]. Active since 1953, Siemens Pakistan is one of the largest providers of engineering services and management in the country, with overseeing ongoing projects in healthcare, defence development, [[Energy in Pakistan|energy]],{{cite web|title=Siemens Energy Sector|url=http://www.siemens.com/about/en/worldwide/pakistan_1154660.htm|publisher=Siemens Energy Sector|accessdate=26 August 2014}} telecommunications, [[Computing in Pakistan|computer]] expansion and [[heavy construction]] management.{{cite web|title=Siemens Pakistan|url=http://www.siemens.com/about/en/worldwide/pakistan_1154660.htm|publisher=Siemens Pakistan|accessdate=26 August 2014}} ==History== Siemens presence in the region dates back to 1870 with the construction of the Indo-European telegraph line from [[London]] to [[Calcutta]]. Siemens established its first office in the area now known as Pakistan in 1922.{{Cite web|url=http://www.brecorder.com/news/3329007|title=Siemens in Pakistan since 1922|date=October 18, 2006|website=Brecorder}}{{Cite web|url=http://www.brecorder.com/news/3106669|title=Siemens Pakistan: Rightful place among the top 25|date=December 3, 2004|website=Brecorder}} In 1952, Siemens formed a [[joint venture]] with the [[Government of Pakistan]] to establish the Telephone Industries of Pakistan (TIP), a telephone equipment manufacturing company, with 30 percent stake.{{Cite web|url=https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2019/04/22/pakistanis-are-starting-to-spend-more-on-healthcare-siemens-is-counting-on-it/|title=Pakistanis are starting to spend more on healthcare. Siemens is counting on it|first=Taimoor Hassan, Farooq|last=Tirmizi|date=April 22, 2019|website=Profit by Pakistan Today}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/403618/phone-factory-facing-closure|title=Phone factory facing closure|date=July 10, 2006|website=DAWN.COM}} TIP produced rotary telephones branded with "TIP" on their dials, which were commonly used in many Pakistani households during the 1990s and earlier. These telephones were manufactured at the TIP facility in [[Haripur, Pakistan|Haripur]], which was established with Siemens' assistance. Siemens formally incorporated its subsidiary in Pakistan as a private limited company in 1953, and later reorganized as a [[public limited company]] in 1963. When founded, Siemens Pakistan was originally focused on providing the network of [[communications in Pakistan|communications]], but its role in the [[Electricity sector in Pakistan|energy sector]] has grown since 1987.{{cite web|title=Milestons of Siemens Pakistan|url=http://www.siemens.com.pk/Milestones.html|publisher=Milestons of Siemens Pakistan|accessdate=26 August 2014}}{{cite web|title=Technological solutions by Siemens Engineering|url=http://www.siemens.com.pk/Prduct_Solution.html|publisher=Technological solutions by Siemens Engineering|accessdate=26 August 2014}} In July 1978, Siemens was listed on the [[Karachi Stock Exchange]].{{Cite web|url=https://khistocks.com/market-live/companies-live/detailed-view/SIEM.html|title=Karachi Stocks | Live SIEM|website=khistocks.com}} In 1997, Siemens established awards for engineering students across Pakistani universities and a three-year apprenticeship course for students in Karachi. By 2002, over 50 percent of telephone networks in Pakistan were using Siemens Pakistan's EWSD technology.{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/47049/siemens-delivers-technology-to-ptcl|title=Siemens delivers technology to PTCL|date=July 11, 2002|website=DAWN.COM}} In 2005, Siemens acquired Carrier Telephone Industries from [[PTCL]] under the privatization scheme of the Government of Pakistan.{{Cite web|url=http://www.brecorder.com/news/3200591|title=Sale of 8016 PTCL shares in CTI to Siemens approved|date=September 13, 2005|website=Brecorder}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/365689/siemens-to-bid-for-ptcl-subsidiary|title=Siemens to bid for PTCL subsidiary|date=July 28, 2004|website=DAWN.COM}} In 2008, Siemens Pakistan expanded its operations to [[Afghanistan]] after acquiring the local assets from Siemens India.{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1228971|title=Shedding fat to be profitable|first=Dilawar|last=Hussain|date=December 28, 2015|website=DAWN.COM}} In April 2015, Siemens sold its distribution transformer manufacturing business along with assets of land and building in [[Sindh Industrial and Trading Estate]] for $32 million.{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1090786|title=Siemens to sell transformer business |date=March 4, 2014|website=DAWN.COM}}{{Cite web|url=https://transformers-magazine.com/tm-news/1877-siemens-to-sell-assets-in-karachi-power-transformer/|title=Siemens to sell assets in Karachi|website=transformers-magazine.com}} In August 2015, Siemens Pakistan decided to transfer its healthcare business sector to a private limited company headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan.{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1197986|title=Siemens' focus on core business|first=Dilawar|last=Hussain|date=August 3, 2015|website=DAWN.COM}} In December 2015, healthcare business ownership was transferred to the German company [[Siemens Healthcare]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1227283|title=Siemens Pakistan to spin off healthcare business |date=December 20, 2015|website=DAWN.COM}} During the same period, it closed down its diesel-generating sets business and non-standard motor business segments. In October 2024, Siemens Pakistan further reduced its operations in Pakistan and sold its energy business to [[Siemens Gamesa]] for PKR 17.8 billion.{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1865254|title=Siemens sells energy unit for Rs17.8bn|date=October 15, 2024|website=DAWN.COM}} ==Services== * Energy management * Digital factory * Process industries and drive ==Management== ===CEOs=== * Sohail Wajahat Siddiqui{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/317096/siemens-restructures-worldwide-operations|title=Siemens restructures worldwide operations|date=August 19, 2008|website=DAWN.COM}} * Ali Hamdani{{Cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/662868/newspaper/newspaper/column|title=Siemens gets new MD|date=September 30, 2011|website=DAWN.COM}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Siemens}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Siemens Pakistan}} [[Category:Siemens|Pakistan]] [[Category:1953 establishments in Pakistan]] [[Category:Pakistani companies established in 1953]] [[Category:1970s initial public offerings]] [[Category:Pakistani subsidiaries of foreign companies]] [[Category:Electronics companies of Pakistan]] [[Category:Companies based in Karachi]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Nuclear technology companies]]

Siemens (Pakistan) Engineering Company Limited is a Pakistani engineering services company headquartered in Karachi. It is a subsidiary of Siemens AG.
Active since 1953, Siemens Pakistan is one of the largest providers of engineering services and management in the country, with overseeing ongoing projects in healthcare, defence development, energy, telecommunications, computer expansion and heavy construction management.
